speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) secondary to prematurity.

The clinical picture of a 33-week newborn with respiratory distress, respiratory acidosis, hypoxemia, and a characteristic "ground-glass" appearance on chest X-ray is classic for Neonatal RDS due to surfactant deficiency.
